pin_title: 7 Christmas Gifts for Him Under £25 UK Shoppers Swear By
pin_title_alt: 3 Easy Christmas Presents for Dad, Husband or Brother
pin_hook: Whisky glasses to stocking fillers - all highly rated
pin_description: Christmas gifts for him under £25: crystal whisky glasses, a hanging wash bag, beard grooming kit, shower steamers and a funny mug. Easy present ideas for dad, husband, brother or boyfriend that UK shoppers rate highly. #ad #christmasgifts #giftsforhim #ukgiftideas
intro: Stuck on what to get the men in your life this Christmas? Here are seven well-reviewed picks that work as a main gift or a stocking filler, all under £25.

products.name: Whisiskey Crystal Whiskey Glass Set
products.headline: A proper dram deserves a proper glass
products.why: Cut-crystal tumblers that look far pricier than they are - a safe bet for whisky fans.

products.name: Hanging Travel Toiletry Bag
products.headline: Keeps the bathroom shelf tidy on every trip
products.why: Unrolls and hangs so everything is visible at once - handy for weekends away or the gym bag.

products.name: Glencairn Whisky Glasses, Set of 2
products.headline: The official glass whisky connoisseurs use
products.why: The tulip shape is designed to bring out a whisky's aroma, and it comes in a neat gift box.

products.name: Beard Grooming Kit for Men
products.headline: Oil, balm and comb sorted in one box
products.why: A no-fuss way to cover beard care for anyone who already has one, or wants to start growing one.

products.name: Linkax Shower Steamers Aromatherapy, 8 Pack
products.headline: An easy stocking filler under £7
products.why: Drop one in the shower for an instant spa-style boost - cheap, light and simple to post or wrap.

products.name: Toiletry Bag for Men, Large Travel Wash Bag
products.headline: A budget-friendly everyday upgrade
products.why: Water-resistant and roomy enough for a full washbag, at a price that works as a smaller extra gift.

products.name: 'I Came I Saw I Forgot' Novelty Mug
products.headline: A cheap laugh for his morning coffee
products.why: A silly, well-rated mug that works nicely as a secret Santa or stocking filler add-on.
